entities.name: SNPN enabled UE
entities.description: A UE that is capable of operating in SNPN access operation mode. Activation and deactivation of SNPN access operation mode is implementation-specific.

entities.name: SNPN access operation mode
entities.description: Operational mode where the UE performs SNPN selection and uses SNPN-specific procedures and parameters.

entities.name: SNPN selection procedure
entities.description: Procedure performed by a UE operating in SNPN access operation mode instead of PLMN selection.

entities.name: Permanently forbidden SNPNs list
entities.description: List maintained per access type and per subscriber data entry for SNPNs that are permanently forbidden.

entities.name: Temporarily forbidden SNPNs list
entities.description: List maintained per access type and per subscriber data entry for SNPNs that are temporarily forbidden.

entities.name: 5GMM cause #74
entities.description: Temporarily not authorized for this SNPN - supported in SNPN but not in PLMN.

entities.name: 5GMM cause #75
entities.description: Permanently not authorized for this SNPN - supported in SNPN but not in PLMN.

entities.name: SNPN onboarding registration
entities.description: Initial registration for onboarding services in SNPN where UE sets 5GS registration type to 'SNPN onboarding registration'.

entities.name: List of subscriber data
entities.description: Storage for subscriber credentials used when accessing SNPN using credentials from a credentials holder.

entities.name: MUSIM UE procedures
entities.description: Procedures that may be used by UEs with multiple valid entries of list of subscriber data, even without multiple USIMs.

relations.description: SNPN enabled UE can operate in SNPN access operation mode.
UE operating in SNPN access operation mode performs SNPN selection procedure.
UE in SNPN access operation mode maintains permanently forbidden SNPNs list.
UE in SNPN access operation mode maintains temporarily forbidden SNPNs list.
SNPN onboarding registration allows UE to be configured with entries in list of subscriber data.
UEs with multiple valid entries in list of subscriber data may use MUSIM UE procedures.
